plugins.name: bytheslice
plugins.description: ByTheSlice runs your project like a grab-and-go pizza shop. v5 delivers in Pies (3 to 8 slice chapters, one PR each). /sell-pie bakes one Pie through context-separated build, test, verify and fix steps, committing and pushing each slice; /box-it-up opens the boundary PR, watches CI and merges. /sell-slice handles one slice with hands-on review. /open-kitchen opens the local read-only 3D kitchen. One-time prep: /setup-shop, /create-menu, /cook-pizzas, /set-display-case, /final-quality-check and /open-the-shop.
